article_title: Karl Bushby 'overwhelmed' at Humber Bridge welcome

tasks.prompt: What is the main focus of the article?
options: Karl Bushby received an emotional welcome near the end of a 28-year walk from South America to Hull.
Karl Bushby announced that he would begin a new journey across Chile.
The Humber Bridge was closed permanently because of thick mist.
A former paratrooper completed a record-breaking car journey.
tasks.correct_answer: Karl Bushby received an emotional welcome near the end of a 28-year walk from South America to Hull.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתמקדת בקבלת הפנים המרגשת שקארל בושבי קיבל כשהתקרב לסיום מסע רגלי שנמשך 28 שנה.

tasks.prompt: Which two rules did Bushby set for his journey?
options: He would travel only at night and carry no money.
He would not return to the UK before completing the journey and would not use transport to advance.
He would avoid bridges and cross every river by boat.
He would visit only countries where English is spoken.
tasks.correct_answer: He would not return to the UK before completing the journey and would not use transport to advance.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בושבי קבע שלא יחזור לבריטניה לפני השלמת המסע ושלא ישתמש בתחבורה כדי להתקדם בו.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “final leg” mean?
options: An injury that stopped the walk
The longest continent in the journey
The last section of a journey
A special type of bridge crossing
tasks.correct_answer: The last section of a journey
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי final leg מתאר את הקטע האחרון במסע, ולא פגיעה גופנית ברגל.

tasks.prompt: Why is the Humber Bridge especially meaningful to Bushby?
options: He helped design it before leaving Britain.
His son was born on the bridge.
It was the only bridge he crossed in 28 years.
It remained an iconic, almost symbolic memory from his early test walk.
tasks.correct_answer: It remained an iconic, almost symbolic memory from his early test walk.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בושבי אמר שכמעט אינו זוכר את הליכת הניסיון המוקדמת שלו, מלבד גשר האמבר, שנשאר עבורו סמל ואיקון.

tasks.prompt: What had Bushby achieved by the time he crossed the Humber Bridge?
options: He had travelled about 31,000 miles over 28 years and crossed four continents.
He had driven from Chile to Hull in one year.
He had completed the journey without ever crossing water.
He had walked only through Europe and South America.
tasks.correct_answer: He had travelled about 31,000 miles over 28 years and crossed four continents.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת מסע של כ־31 אלף מייל במשך 28 שנה, שכלל ארבע יבשות וגם ים קפוא, מדבריות, הרים וג'ונגלים.

tasks.prompt: What does Bushby mean when he calls his cart “my Wilson”?
options: The cart was built by a company called Wilson.
The cart is a companion he has relied on, like the volleyball in Cast Away.
The cart belongs to his son Wilson.
The cart is used only when he crosses water.
tasks.correct_answer: The cart is a companion he has relied on, like the volleyball in Cast Away.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההשוואה ל־Wilson מהסרט Cast Away מציגה את העגלה כבת לוויה קבועה במסע הארוך.

tasks.prompt: Describe three major stages or achievements in Bushby's journey from Chile to Hull.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה שלבים מדויקים בסדר כרונולוגי ככל האפשר.
expected_points: He left Punta Arenas, Chile, in 1998 with little money and headed north.
He crossed four continents as well as a frozen sea, deserts, mountains and jungles.
He swam across the English Channel on 5 October.
He crossed the Humber Bridge on the final leg before walking from Hessle into Hull.

tasks.prompt: Why did the crowds on the Humber Bridge make Bushby stop and think about the meaning of his journey?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את הפער בין האופן הצנוע שבו הוא מתאר את עצמו לבין תגובת הציבור, ולבסס על דבריו.
expected_points: Bushby described himself modestly as a homeless man pushing a shopping trolley.
He did not expect such a large public welcome before even reaching home.
The crowd showed that his personal endurance story had become meaningful to many other people.
The bridge already carried strong personal symbolism for him.

tasks.prompt: Summarise Bushby's journey, his rules and his homecoming in 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את נקודת ההתחלה, משך ומרחק המסע, שני הכללים וקבלת הפנים.
expected_points: Bushby left Chile in 1998 and spent 28 years travelling roughly 31,000 miles toward Hull.
He promised not to return to the UK before completing the journey and not to use transport to advance.
His route crossed four continents and many extreme landscapes.
Crowds welcomed him at the Humber Bridge before his final walk to his mother's home.

tasks.prompt: Write a short welcome message for Bushby's reception in Queen Victoria Square.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב מסר קצר וחגיגי המבוסס על עובדות מדויקות מהכתבה, ללא המצאת שיאים או פרסים.
expected_points: Welcome Bushby back to Hull after 28 years.
Mention the long journey from Chile and his persistence.
Refer to the Humber Bridge or the support of the local crowd.
